description: Unit test class for ImmutableAclEntry, verifying immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and behavior with different permissions and authorization subjects.

classes.name: ImmutableAclEntryTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for ImmutableAclEntry, testing immutability, JSON conversions, equality, and permission checks.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableAclEntry is immutable and its collections are unmodifiable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Uses EqualsVerifier to test correctness of equals and hashCode implementations.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullAclPermission
methods.description: Tests that creating an ImmutableAclEntry with null permissions throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Tests that creating an ImmutableAclEntry with null AuthorizationSubject throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: entryDoesNotContainNullPermission
methods.description: Tests that the entry correctly reports not containing null permission.

methods.name: entryDoesNotContainAllPermissionsForNull
methods.description: Tests that containsAll returns false when checking with null.

methods.name: entryDoesNotContainAllPermissions
methods.description: Tests that containsAll correctly returns false for missing permissions.

methods.name: entryContainsAllPermissions
methods.description: Tests that containsAll returns true when permissions are present.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceFromNullJsonObject
methods.description: Verifies that passing null to fromJson throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceFromEmptyJsonObject
methods.description: Verifies that passing empty JsonObject to fromJson throws DittoJsonException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceFromJsonObjectContainingSchemaVersionOnly
methods.description: Verifies that a JsonObject with only schema version throws DittoJsonException.

methods.name: createInstanceFromJsonObjectContainingMoreThanOneAclEntry
methods.description: Tests creating ImmutableAclEntry from a JSON with multiple ACL entries, and verifies correct parsing.

methods.name: createInstanceFromJsonObjectContainingOnlyInvalidPermissions
methods.description: Verifies that invalid permissions in JSON cause AclEntryInvalidException.

methods.name: toJsonWithSchemaVersion1ReturnsJsonObjectWithRegularFieldsOnly
methods.description: Tests the toJson method for schema version 1, ensuring correct JSON structure.

methods.name: createAuthorizationSubjectContainsSlash
methods.description: Verifies that creating AuthorizationSubject with a slash-separated string works without error.
